context: Organization type resolver walks up the `parentId` chain to build an `ancestors` list for breadcrumb navigation.
explanation: The cycle guard (the `visited` set and the check against it) is removed. If org data ever ends up with a circular parent reference — a bad migration, a bug in the reparenting mutation, or a malicious admin edit — this resolver loops forever, calling the loader on the same ids repeatedly until the process hangs or runs out of memory. Fix: keep the visited-set guard so any cycle in the data breaks the loop instead of crashing the server.
